headline: Ansar Allah rejects holy-site targeting allegations as Makkah drone claim stands contested
dek: The coalition says its air defences intercepted and destroyed an Ansar Allah drone in the Makkah region before it entered restricted airspace (0900-01). Aggregators (EconoTimes, CryptoBriefing, TokenPost, 03:59-04:35Z) report the movement denied targeting Mecca and called the accusation fabricated.
sources: Saudi-led coalition spokesman Maj Gen Turki al-Maliki (X statement via Reuters/JPost) vs Ansar Allah position via PressTV (al-Ansar Allah speech) and aggregator reports of denial
fault_line: Holy city or military corridor? The Makkah region holds Jeddah, Taif and the Rabigh refinery Saree named — was the drone aimed at a holy city, or is 'Mecca' the frame Riyadh uses and Sanaa rejects?

sections.what_happened: The coalition says its air defences intercepted and destroyed an Ansar Allah drone in the Makkah region before it entered restricted airspace (0900-01). Aggregators (EconoTimes, CryptoBriefing, TokenPost, 03:59-04:35Z) report the movement denied targeting Mecca and called the accusation fabricated. The ON-RECORD rejection retrieved is Ansar Allah leader Abdel-Malik al-Ansar Allah's Oct 29 Martyrs' Day speech (PressTV): he 'strongly rejected Saudi allegations that Yemen intended to attack the Islamic holy sites in Mecca and Medina, describing the claims as baseless' — a general rejection delivered BEFORE the Oct 30 drone, not a statement about the Oct 30 drone itself. No named Oct 30 statement from Saree or al-Ansar Allah about the Oct 30 drone was retrieved; Reuters/JPost (06:21 Oct 30) still carried 'no immediate comment from the Ansar Allah'.
sections.what_verified: 2 declared families for the claim-vs-denial FRAME: Reuters (T1, coalition statement via JPost) + IRNA/Press TV (T3, STATE IR, al-Ansar Allah speech). EconoTimes/CryptoBriefing/TokenPost carry the denial but have NO declared tier and are NOT counted. The specific claim 'Ansar Allah denied the Oct 30 drone' is NOT corroborated by a declared family and must not be stated as a confirmed quote.
sections.what_disputed: TRAP AVOIDED: the Roya News piece headlined 'Ansar Allah deny drone was aimed at Mecca' recycles the SEPTEMBER incident (Hizam al-Asad tweet Sept 16, 2026; coalition statement 21:50 GMT Sept 15) — it is NOT an Oct 30 denial and must never be cited as one. The coalition's own account places the interception OUTSIDE restricted airspace, not a strike inside Mecca city (0900-01 constraint stands). Saree's Oct 29 six-target claim (Ras Tanura, Rabigh, Abqaiq, Riyadh/Dammam airports, Najran HQ) remains unconfirmed by Saudi authorities or Aramco; only the two Riyadh-bound missiles match an official Saudi statement.
sections.why_matters: Claim-busting follow-up to 0900-01: 'Mecca: what was actually claimed, what is actually denied.' Lead with the coalition's own outside-restricted-airspace wording, then the denial frame with its dating honestly stated (Oct 29 speech + unattributed aggregator denial reports). NEVER present the September Roya denial as the Oct 30 response, and NEVER present the drone as a strike inside Mecca city.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP / COUNTERPOINT DEVELOPMENT -- Ansar Allah rejects holy-site targeting allegations as Makkah drone claim stands contested; no named on-record denial of the specific Oct 30 drone retrieved
